'''Marina Volkhova''' was a Vorkutan labor organizer associated with the practical implementation of [[Gorodovaya Syndikalizm]].

== Labor Crisis Role ==

During the [[Vorkutan Labor Crisis]] of 1924-1926, Volkhova helped turn worker assemblies into the first city kollektivy. These bodies controlled industrial districts and became the core organizational units later formalized during the [[Vorkutan Great Reorganization]].

The source presents Volkhova as the key organizer of the crisis-era assemblies, but does not give her formal office, faction, or later career.
